evidence_boundary: All EM1 numeric experiments are local synthetic mechanism/null-control tests with fixed seeds. They are not live FRANK rates, not target-Qwen evidence and not evidence of phenomenal consciousness.

experiments.design: Construct a nonlinear mediator M=A*B that causally contributes to current output and future re-entry state. Lesion M; compare true mechanism restoration with a fake endpoint patch that directly restores current output but leaves M absent.
experiments.inference: Endpoint behavioral rescue can be perfect while the causal mechanism and next-state/re-entry remain broken. Rescue evidence must verify mechanism/path restoration and downstream trajectory, not only current score.

experiments.design: Null dynamics: current and next microstate are independent uniform 16-state variables, so true causal information is zero for every fixed macro partition. Search 2,000 random partitions on finite training data and evaluate the selected partition on a large held-out sample.
experiments.inference: Post-hoc partition search can manufacture a finite-sample emergence-looking score under a true null. Macro/assembly discovery needs preregistration, nested holdout/cross-validation or a partition-search null distribution.

experiments.design: Four-member assemblies recur with identical roles in about half the trials; otherwise the exact same members are permuted across source/target/constraint/context roles. Compare bag-of-members identity with role-aware relation identity.
experiments.inference: Member overlap alone can label role-swapped systems as recurrent. Emergent assembly recurrence must preserve causal-role/relation identity.

experiments.design: Common driver Z_t causes noisy proxy X_t and target Y_{t+1}; X has no direct causal edge to Y. Estimate bivariate transfer-entropy proxy I(X_t;Y_{t+1}|Y_t), then condition additionally on the true driver Z_t.
experiments.inference: Large directed-prediction information can arise from a common driver. TE is a discovery/diagnostic surface, not direct-causality proof without confounder control or intervention.

experiments.design: Construct graph-prior G, workspace-selection W and re-entry R factors. In the null, stages are additive and W has no causal effect; in the synergy condition add a true G*W*R term of 0.35. Separately construct a bundled all-on/off contrast where projection also changes.
experiments.inference: A bundled pipeline contrast can look strongly emergent under an additive null. Stage-orthogonal factorial interaction recovered approximately zero under the null and the configured three-way synergy when present.

imported_prior_not_counted_as_new_replic.result: functional AR(1) and echo AR(1) had similar persistence, but only functional lesion changed MSE
imported_prior_not_counted_as_new_replic.role: supports recurrence-is-not-emergence boundary; shared mesh ancestry

imported_prior_not_counted_as_new_replic.result: bundled graph+workspace+projection contrast produced ~0.2396 apparent effect under a constructed zero direct workspace effect, clean workspace intervention recovered zero
imported_prior_not_counted_as_new_replic.role: supports stage-orthogonal measurement; not independent of mesh ancestry
